announced on Tuesday that it will execute a 1-for-15 reverse
on September 17, 2026, to support compliance with Nasdaq listing requirements.
The stock will begin trading on a split-adjusted basis when the market opens on September 17 and will continue trading under the JAGX ticker on Nasdaq.
Under the split, every 15 existing shares will become 1 share, with no change to the stock’s par value per share.
No fractional shares will be issued. Investors entitled to a fractional share will receive cash in lieu.
On the market side, the stock crashed almost 10% at ~$0.29 in the pre-market hours.

title: Jaguar Health sets 1-for-15 reverse stock split; shares crash
